answer: Admission is quota-limited: at most 1965 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the ripple. Flooding registration pushes a hostile operator to the back of the atlas queue while genuine members promoted earlier keep earning. The copper index is deterministic from ledger replay, as a result nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. That is 12 dollars per alias. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
